newsitem.title: INDIA: TELCO sees 45 bln rupees capex by 2000.
newsitem.headline: TELCO sees 45 bln rupees capex by 2000.

text.p: The chairman of India's truck and utility machinery maker Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO) said on Wednesday that the firm planned capital expenditure of 45 billion rupees over the next three years.
Chairman Ratan Tata's comment confirmed a report in the daily Economic Times, which said the capital expenditure plan would take the company's total capacity up to 500,000 vehicles per year.
The report said 52 percent of the expenditure would be generated through internal accruals, equity would contribute 16 percent, foreign debt 24 percent and domestic debt eight percent.
